description.value: Deville Coffee is a locally owned specialty coffee chain founded in 2008 and now operating across Alberta and BC, including Vancouver. The café brews small-batch, direct-trade beans — sourced from farms in Guatemala and Brazil — crafted into espresso drinks with house-made ingredients like chocolate ganache and organic vanilla. A rotating menu of daily pastries and creative breakfast wraps and sandwiches rounds out the offering.
